===='''Santa Cruz, CA KoD signing, 29 October 2005 - report by hermano de lobos'''====
''originally posted at Wotmania''



'''KOD Santa Cruz Book Signing....No spoilers I think<br />'''hermano de lobos - 10/29/2005 9:14:38 PM



I just got back from the book signing for KOD in Santa Cruz, CA. It was basically the same old same old. But one person asked something to the effect of How valid are the viewings and prophecies, given that the pattern has been loosened. There was also a comment by the person about how the viewings and prophecies are readings of the pattern.

Jordan responded, (not word for word) The views and prophecies that occured before the loosening of the pattern are very valid. But those that occured at, or after, the loosening have a higher chance of not coming true.

I thought this was pretty big news.

I don't have the best memory in the world, so my wording may be a little off. Feel free to correct me if you were there.
